input:
EARLIER SCENES (context only):
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。
他的妈妈觉得在墓地玩儿，害得，所以他们搬家。搬家对孟子有好的影响，他才五岁，可是每天不是写字就是帮妈妈的工作。
CURRENT SCENE:
他很聪明的人，难怪他成为有名的人。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P48] 他【^】很聪明的人
  proposed by the AI checker: 他[+是个]很聪明的人 (a noun predicate needs 是个 here)
  proposed by the correction model: 他[+是]很聪明的人
  her past correction (become_and_profession): 结果他[成为很聪明的人→变得越来越聪明] — her note: 成为 + profession/celebrity
  her past correction (adversative_connector): ⟦可是⟧他很聪明 — her note: no “semantic turn” relationship, so可是is inappropriate
  her past correction (other_vs_additional): [别的人→人们]觉得他很聪明 — her note: “别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
  rule card become_and_profession: 成为 is followed by an appropriate N., especially a profession or public identity: 成为 + N. (profession/celebrity). For becoming successful or capable, use 成才. Not an error: Do not flag 成为 when it is followed by an appropriate noun, especially a profession or public identity, such as 成为哲学家.
  rule card adversative_connector: Use 可是, 却, 而, and 但 only when there is a real “semantic turn,” such as a contrast or an unexpected result. 却 indicates an unexpected semantic turn. Not an error: Use 却 when the result is an unexpected semantic turn.

[P49] 难怪【他】成为有名的人
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 难怪[-他]成为有名的人 (他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form)
  her past correction (become_and_profession): 难怪他成为很聪明[+的人]
  her past correction (word_class_choice): 难怪他成为[名的→有名的]哲学家
  her past correction (become_and_profession): 难怪他长大以后[当→成为]很有名的哲学家
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card become_and_profession: 成为 is followed by an appropriate N., especially a profession or public identity: 成为 + N. (profession/celebrity). For becoming successful or capable, use 成才. Not an error: Do not flag 成为 when it is followed by an appropriate noun, especially a profession or public identity, such as 成为哲学家.

Repeated subject can be omitted in a close continuation.
